definitions.analyses: an Analysis is its (store, analysis_id): the one #409's judgement names, then one from each other z_band, in the order `draws` lists the bands, each drawn with one numpy default_rng(seed) from that band's Analyses with at least as many r^2 0.01 index variants as the named one, listed by analysis_id then store
definitions.window: the 10,000,000 bp window [p, p + 10,000,000) starting at one of the Analysis's index variants that holds the most index variants; ties go to the first in genome order (chromosome 1-22 by number, then others by name, then position)
definitions.view: the window's shared-set rows from first to last, padded by 4% of that span (at least 20,000 bp) each side, never below 0
definitions.genome_index_variants: every plink2 index variant of the Analysis, in genome order: the positions the window is chosen from
definitions.rows: every 5e-8 row of the shared set in the view, by position
definitions.not_drawn: the Analysis's observed 5e-8 rows in the view that are not in the shared set, so are not drawn and not clumped: how many, the largest |z| among them (null when none), and how many fall under each of #403's partition reasons
definitions.clump: a clump with a row in the view, numbered 1, 2, ... in the Locus Lead ranking of its index variant (abs_z descending, then Store Variant Index); rows, start and end count all its members on the chromosome, in the view or not
definitions.leads: each method's leads in the view; agreed when the lead is also a plink2 index variant, spurious_split when plink2 puts it inside a stronger variant's clump; lost counts the index variants in the view that the method merged into a stronger lead
definitions.blocks: the EUR LD blocks that overlap the view, half-open [start, end)
definitions.profile: the prominence rule's envelope: the largest |z| of the Analysis's observed 5e-4 rows in each 50,000 bp bin (bin = position // bin_bp) covering the view; null where the bin holds no 5e-4 row

methods.label: cM rule, D 2.5 cM, W 10 Mb
